summary: Re-verification of Timer CasparCG backend after Windows launcher script changes (deploy/*.bat, deploy/install.ps1). No server.py changes this iteration. Ran full backend pytest suite (5 tests) covering GET /api/status shape, idle detection, OSC->status pipeline via test_osc_sender.py (filenames + time_left math), LIVE status when total=0, and WebSocket /api/ws streaming. All 5/5 tests passed in 7.89s. Backend code is healthy; user's Windows startup problem is isolated to the launcher environment, not server.py.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown; migrate to lifespan handler eventually.

MongoDB client instantiated at import time but unused; requires MONGO_URL/DB_NAME env vars just to boot — on Windows this could cause a KeyError if the launcher does not set them. Consider making Mongo optional or wrap in try/except so backend boots even without Mongo (relevant to the Windows launch issue user is hitting).
OSC_HOST defaults to 0.0.0.0 which is fine on Linux but on Windows the firewall may block UDP 7250; user-facing docs / launcher should prompt for firewall rule.
WebSocket endpoint has no server-side ping/keepalive.
seed_data_creation: None. OSC simulated via /app/backend/test_osc_sender.py during test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Windows-specific issue: check that the launcher (.bat/install.ps1) sets MONGO_URL and DB_NAME in backend/.env before starting uvicorn, otherwise `mongo_client = AsyncIOMotorClient(os.environ['MONGO_URL'])` at module import will raise KeyError and the server won't start. This is the most likely Windows-boot failure cause.
